description: Add an identity concept at zero usage, or add text as an alias using alias_of. Requires editor; resolution may incur embedding/judge cost. Probe first; if the text already resolves to an incumbent, offer that concept instead of blindly retrying. Aliases resolving to another concept are refused. embedding_model selects a new type's space only. Returns concept details and link; manage existing aliases with update_concept_alias. See enricher://docs/semantic-ids.

alias_of.description: semantic_id of the concept this text is a surface form of; omit to add a standalone concept.
alias_of.title: Alias Of

concept_type.description: Concept type the text belongs to.
concept_type.title: Concept Type

embedding_model.description: Composite key (provider::model) to embed a NEW concept type under.
embedding_model.title: Embedding Model

judge_floor.description: Similarity at or above which a candidate is put to the identity judge. Omit to use the organization default (Settings → Organization).
judge_floor.title: Judge Floor

name: add_semantic_concept
title: Add semantic concept
